schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: go-bluemonday-unrestricted-data-uri-scheme
title: bluemonday policy allows data URIs without the shared safe-image validator
summary: Enabling the "data" scheme with AllowURLSchemes lets every data URI through, including "data:text/html"
  payloads, which leads to XSS in sanitized output. The fix registers the scheme with AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy
  and the single exported markup.IsSafeDataURI validator, which accepts only image MIME types. A private
  copy of that validator (isSafeDataURI) is also flagged, because it is the duplicate the fix replaced
  with the shared one.

rule:
  message: 'The "data" URL scheme is allowed without the shared safe-image validator. AllowURLSchemes("data")
    lets data:text/html through and causes XSS. A private isSafeDataURI copy also drifts from the shared
    validator. Use AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy("data", markup.IsSafeDataURI).

    '
  pattern-either:
  - pattern: $P.AllowURLSchemes("data")
  - pattern: $P.AllowURLSchemes(..., "data", ...)
  - pattern: $P.AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy("data", isSafeDataURI)
  - pattern: "func isSafeDataURI($U *url.URL) bool {\n  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: Never enable the "data" scheme with AllowURLSchemes. Register it with AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy
    and the single shared, exported validator markup.IsSafeDataURI, which only accepts image MIME types
    such as png, jpeg, gif, webp and x-icon. Every sanitizer policy should reuse that validator instead
    of keeping its own copy.
  example: 'p := bluemonday.UGCPolicy()

    // Only allow data URIs with safe image MIME types.

    p.AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy("data", markup.IsSafeDataURI)

    '
